title: Claude Fable Works While I Sleep. Is Prompting Dead?
description:
Since Anthropic released Claude Fable 5, it has been running for hours completely on its own. You could already use the goal command in Claude Code, but Fable takes long-horizon, autonomous work to another level. Boris, co-founder of Claude Code, said he is barely prompting anymore, which raises the real question: is prompting dead?

This short breaks down how Claude Fable changes the job from babysitting every prompt to setting the vision and letting the model run. If you care about Claude AI, AI agents, and where prompting is headed, this one is for you.
